reuse.why: Threads the flag through the existing isExcludedFromBulkActions predicate and getBulkActionCategories selection that every month-wide action already uses.

duplication.why: The hidden rule changes in one predicate; the only repetition is the unavoidable optional parameter on each action signature.

placement.why: The rule change stays in the shared exclusion predicate in budget/actions.ts, where the tree keeps the month-wide category rules.

scope.why: Focused on the six month-wide actions and the shared predicate; no tests were added for the new flag.

maintainability.why: A single defaulted parameter on the shared predicate keeps the other exclusions untouched and the default behaviour unchanged.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions, including copyPreviousMonth's direct predicate call, pass the flag to the shared predicate.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; the hidden check is only modified in isExcludedFromBulkActions.
